purpose: Permanently exclude every event used, admitted, or model-blind-selected as a candidate by BurnLens Experiments One through Three before Experiment Four candidate enumeration.

policy.experiment_one_fallback: Until an official incident identifier is separately admitted, an exact normalized name-year match or later-proven geometry overlap with an Experiment One event is excluded; ambiguity remains unknown and excluded.
policy.no_selection_claim: This manifest excludes prior events only. It does not admit a source, define the new candidate universe, select an Experiment Four event, or authorize source-body access.
policy.immutability: Entries are never removed. A correction creates a successor record and retains the prior entry.

limitations: Experiment One accepted records do not expose a single official incident identifier for each event; their exclusions are bound to project event, geography, time, and exact source-scene identities.
Experiment Two-B continuation records are dirty-worktree evidence and may be stale or superseded. Their only use here is conservative exclusion, never proof of an accepted cohort or result.
Names alone never establish a fresh-event match. Ambiguous name-year or spatial relationships remain unknown and excluded until exact admitted metadata resolves them.
